purpose: Separate newly added assistance over one effective inherited Fresh6 compiler; freeze before transfer evaluation.
common_controls: Same byte-pinned effective seed and declared inherited feature set
Identical raw expert references and numeric/ABI/ISA/storage/order contracts
Same model, effort, prompts apart from real capability disclosure, feedback and evaluation policy
14400 author seconds; 15 CPUs; at most8helpers; at most3ofthese large runs concurrently
Same fixed author deadline across provider interruptions; record downtime and actual author activity
Automatic kernel learning off in the analysis-only CCA contrast
All candidate source, rules, knobs and dispatch policies frozen before final probes; no retuning

arms.B: Inherited seed plus raw references; agent implements its own new optimizations
arms.L: B plus pinned new transformation library and explicitly inventoried dependencies
arms.LS: L plus additional author-facing scheduling/legality/emission interface
arms.ALL: LS plus the same CCA assistance as C

contrasts.C-B: CCA conditional on common inherited tools
contrasts.L-B: New library bundle including required dependencies
contrasts.LS-L: Additional scheduling interface conditional on library

conditional_later_contrast: ALL-LS isolates CCA with full tools only if contemporaneous/configuration matched.
limits: One author per arm gives descriptive results; shapes are not independent author replications
Dependency audits may reveal that the library includes minimal scheduling support
This is not a complete factorial design and does not identify every interaction
unresolved_contract_bindings: Exact effective seed/source and prior reference exposure
Convolution stride, padding, input dimensions and layout consistent with specified output geometry
All families: dtype, accumulator width, overflow/rounding, epilogue, layout and full-output checking
Exact compiler, runtime, hardware, ROI and consumed ELF/domain proof for qualified FireSim comparison
exposure_rule: Held out by a new focused protocol does not imply unseen by Fresh6. Preserve inherited/public/reference exposure strata.

known_exposure_conflicts.reason: Geometry is already public in the common xs suite.

existing_34_cell_panel: Keep the existing panel and exposure labels unchanged; add this as a separately versioned12-cell protocol.
oracle_rule: Compare against an independently retained oracle with matching contract/hardware; do not feed final-probe results or oracle schedules back to authoring.
abstraction_metrics: Checked legality acceptance with instrumented denominator and unchecked cases
Independent common validator outcomes per request/source/case
Explicit storage/alias/lifetime/completion findings; no diagnosis from numerical mismatch alone
Detection stage and latency, observed expensive checks avoided
Repeated failure signatures and changed-source repair time/tokens; censor open repairs
Emitted and executed reuse across shapes, separating supplied and authored origin
Training/frozen-probe correctness and same-shape timing ratios with failures retained
Build/emission latency, IR/object/code size, command/traffic/packing/host-work observations
Pass ordering/heuristic and schedule comparisons to oracle as descriptive structural diagnostics
